note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Buzek's AWS-UW government), not measured data. The ruling AWS was built around the Solidarity trade union; the Catholic Church held strong social influence; agrarian parties represented a large farming population.

interest_groups.note: The Solidarity trade union led the ruling AWS alliance.
A large share of employment was still in agriculture.
Small German, Belarusian, Ukrainian and other minorities.
